blockers.description: No PostgreSQL server is installed on this machine. The postgresql-x64-17 Windows service is a stale registration whose ImagePath points at C:\Program Files\PostgreSQL\17\bin\pg_ctl.exe, a path that no longer exists. C:\Program Files\PostgreSQL\18\ holds only an orphaned data\ directory with no bin\. None of psql/postgres/pg_ctl/initdb is on PATH or under Program Files, LOCALAPPDATA, scoop, or chocolatey. Nothing listens on 5432-5435.
blockers.workaround: Install a local PostgreSQL server. This single action unblocks all three deferred UAT items. Note redis-server IS running and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY IS present in apps/api/.env — neither was ever the blocker.

decisions.decision: CAP-05: enabled is an owner-controlled authorization toggle, not a tightness dimension
decisions.rationale: It has no numeric or ordinal 'how much' to bound; the platform-default gate made every skill permanently un-enablable

decisions.decision: ACT-07 OD-1: IDV is not re-checked at resolution
decisions.rationale: No customer session token exists outside an agent turn. Bounded by step 2.5 preceding step 5 (every require_human row was created by a call holding a valid session) and _CONFIRM_TTL_HOURS = 24. Accepted as T-22-ACT-08

decisions.decision: ACT-07 OD-2: expiry is lazy, no background sweep task
decisions.rationale: The CASE inside the atomic claim is strictly stronger than a sweep, and a sweep's own live-DB proof is unrunnable here. Named exclusion, follow-up logged

decisions.decision: ACT-07 OD-3: execution outcome is a read-time tool_calls_audit lookup, no 0020 migration
decisions.rationale: Discriminated by actor_decision = 'approved_by_human'; without that predicate the lookup matches the ORIGINAL require_human row (same agent/skill/arguments) and would report an execution that never happened

decisions.decision: ACT-07 OD-6: commit the atomic claim BEFORE dispatching the Celery task
decisions.rationale: Overturned 22-PATTERNS.md, which showed .delay() immediately before await db.commit(). A task dispatched before a durable claim can be picked up by a worker reading the pre-claim row

decisions.decision: Phase 19 gap 2 was scoped OUT to Phase 22 rather than fixed in place
decisions.rationale: It required security-sensitive production code in a phase deliberately scoped as documentation-only. Operator chose the properly-planned follow-up over a gap-pass bolt-on

Prior phases' deferrals were ENVIRONMENT deferrals that close with provisioning. This was a capability the product did not have. Amended in place on 2026-07-28 once Phase 22 closed both causes — moved to 'unproven', never to 'passed'

decisions.decision: UI: enabled False→True stages only when agent.is_deployed === true
decisions.rationale: That is the one condition where the write is live against a real customer with no downstream gate. Verified is_deployed is a real, already-typed field used elsewhere on the page

decisions.decision: UI: no pass chip on a merely-approved row
decisions.rationale: Verdict-only colour is the system's law; the queue must not assert an execution it cannot confirm. Locked mute 'Approved · Awaiting execution' instead
